als.normalization: deposited edgeR TMM log2-CPM matrix (protein-coding); independent TMM reimplementation cross-check (median r=0.97)
als.test: per-gene OLS log2FC with limma-style empirical Bayes moderated t (fitFDist); BH FDR
als.note: Batch (Study_1 vs Study_2/4/5) is fully confounded with group; results should be interpreted with this limitation.

wilson.normalization: deposited log2 signals; probe-level values collapsed to gene symbol mean
wilson.test: per-gene OLS log2FC with limma-style empirical Bayes moderated t (fitFDist); BH FDR
wilson.note: Small cohort (7 WD vs 8 control); controls have other liver pathology; WD cases all cirrhotic.
